issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body:
Measure how the running time of insertion sort and merge sort grows with the input size n (n = 1000, 2000, 4000, 8000, 16000, random integers, 5 repeats each), and check the growth against the expected n^2 and n log n shapes.

Deliver the timing table, a log-log figure with both curves, the analysis code, and a short report `report/report.md` (Markdown is enough) saying whether the measured growth matches the expected shapes.
